newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe key index drops but seen temporary.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe key index drops but seen temporary.

text.p: Zimbabwe's key industrial index dropped 13.29 points to 10,897.97 on Thursday but brokers said this was a temporay hitch only brought on by losses in some heavyweight counters.
"The index shed a few points but largely because some big counters lost. I think the market is still looking quite firm on the whole," one broker said.
The day's losers included Zimbabwe Sugar Refineries which shed 20 cents to 1,630 while Industrial Holdings Limited lost 50 cents to 2,400 and blue chip bankers Barclays were down 100 cents to 3,400.
Minings continued quiet with most counters trading largely unchanged but coal producing giant Wankie put on 10 to 600 and the secondary index there inched 3.74 points higher to 870.77.
